content:
Thunderbird for Android doesn't currently offer an app lock feature.

You can show support for the feature by voting for it on Mozilla connect linked below. https://connect.mozilla.org/t5/ideas/biometrics-to-open-thunderbird-android/idi-p/74741

An an alternative, your phone may already offer functionality to do this. Try searching your phone for terms such as Secure folder, app lock or private space.

See the below example for Samsung secure folder. https://gadgets.beebom.com/guides/how-to-lock-apps-in-samsung-phones
